reports/Indian_Watchlist_to_Shortlist_20.summary: Four IN watchlist candidates were rejected after verified Stage 4 and hard-gate failures; dossiers document the evidence required to reopen research.
highlights: MHRIL cash-flow proxy relabeled and sustainable FCF left N/A pending note-level bridge.
REPRO sensitivity range corrected to span bear and bull endpoints.
All four dossier citation and readability validators pass.
